name: glyphtrail
description: Query your codebase as a semantic and historical graph.
long_description: Glyphtrail maps a repository as a semantic and historical graph: definitions, calls, imports, inheritance, and cross-boundary API links. This bundle runs the bundled `glyphtrail` binary as an MCP server (stdio) so an agent can locate code, trace callers/callees, follow API flow, and compute the blast radius of a change. The repository must already be indexed with `glyphtrail analyze`.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search over symbol names and doc comments.

tools.name: callers
tools.description: Symbols that call the named symbol.

tools.name: neighbors
tools.description: Direct graph neighbours of the named symbol.

tools.name: endpoints
tools.description: List server-side API endpoints with their handlers.

tools.name: serves
tools.description: Endpoint(s) serving a path (template- and value-aware).

tools.name: who_calls
tools.description: Client call sites that invoke an endpoint.

tools.name: api_impact
tools.description: Cross-boundary view of an endpoint: clients, handlers, schema ops.

tools.name: impact
tools.description: Blast radius of a change: symbol, file, or git change set.

tools.name: outline
tools.description: Symbol outline of a file or directory with signatures.

tools.name: list_repos
tools.description: List repositories indexed in the global registry.

tools.name: analyze
tools.description: (Re)index a repository so queries reflect the latest state.

repo.title: Repository
repo.description: The repository to query. Index it first with `glyphtrail analyze <path>`.
